description: Run for the Rescues 5k Lace Up Your Running Shoes and Help Shelter Animals! Sign up for the 2026 Run for the Rescues 5K, a fun event for the entire family to support Lumpkin County Animal Services in Dahlonega. Whether you're a seasoned runner or prefer a leisurely walk, this event welcomes participants of all fitness levels — and their four-legged companions! This year is extra special! Groundbreaking has officially begun on the brand-new Lumpkin County Animal Shelter, a facility that will let us help even more of our community's needy animals. title: Gold City Lions Club meeting
description: Gold City Lions Club meeting The newly forming Gold City Lions Club offers those with servant hearts the opportunity to serve Dahlonega and Lumpkin County whenever and wherever there is a need. We serve several local non-profits with volunteers to do eye screenings for elementary school children. We serve the Dahlonega and Lumpkin County Chamber of Commerce members when they need volunteers with parking, ticket sales, and vending when they have events.
